question: According to the Census of India 2011, which Union Territory recorded the lowest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, Dadra and Nagar Haveli recorded the lowest literacy rate among Union Territories, with a literacy rate of **76.2%**.
 
• This Union Territory comprises a predominantly tribal population, which has historically faced challenges in accessing education.
 
• In contrast, the highest literacy rate among Union Territories was recorded in Lakshadweep at **91.85%**, as per the 2011 Census.
 
• The low literacy rate in Dadra and Nagar Haveli can be attributed to factors such as **geographical isolation, economic constraints, and socio-cultural barriers**.
 
• The Government has initiated various schemes to improve literacy rates in the region, such as setting up schools and adult education programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate:**

 
 
• The literacy rate is defined as the percentage of literate persons aged seven years and above.
 
• It is a key indicator of a region's educational development and human resource potential.
 
 
 
• **Census of India 2011:**
 
 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years and provides comprehensive demographic, social, and economic data.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census since 1872 and included vital data on population, literacy, and housing.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Tribal Education:**
 
 
• Tribal regions often face high dropout rates due to poverty, lack of infrastructure, and cultural factors.
 
• Language barriers and insufficient availability of teachers also contribute to lower literacy rates in tribal areas.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• The Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) aims to provide universal elementary education across India, including tribal areas.
 
• Special focus is given to marginalized communities under schemes such as the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) program.
